question: The word "ostensibly" most nearly means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Supposedly or apparently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ostensibly"** means:

 
 
• Appearing or claiming to be one thing when it is really something else; supposedly or apparently. (प्रकट रूप से)
 
 
 
• **Example:** He left ostensibly to take care of some business, but everyone knew he just wanted to avoid the meeting.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured her a perfect score.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Supposedly or apparently**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Secretly** (गुप्त रूप से): In a way that is hidden or not intended to be seen or known by others.

 
 
• **Example:** They secretly planned a surprise party for her birthday.
 
 
 
• **Certainly** (निश्चित रूप से): In a definite and confident way; without any doubt.
 
 
• **Example:** She will certainly pass her exams with flying colors.
 
 
 
• **Permanently** (स्थायी रूप से): In a way that lasts or remains unchanged indefinitely; forever.
 
 
• **Example:** The scar on his hand will remain permanently.
 
 

45:Tc18,

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To absorb or include.</
